Light: the globe turns half a turn, and a beat behind it the zone dial's minute hand swings half a turn to the new time, stops dead, ticks back and settles, the hour hand following it geared 12:1; the new time stays. Strong: the globe and the minute hand wind back first, the globe spins faster, and the hand lands harder with two ticks back. Neither hand passes the new time. The reset fades the hands back.

icons.name: availability
icons.heading: Availability
icons.description: The open slot is pulled out to be picked. Light: the free slot slides out to the right, hits its stop, recoils a little and settles, and stays open; the two busy slots never move. Strong: the slot is pushed in first, then pulled out hard to its stop and settles in two beats. The reverse pushes it home against its stop.
